correctness.rationale: Explicit independent-cap area and total-mean-curvature formulas recover the original symmetric equations; analytic u-series through degree three and implicit area adjustment establish a uniform C2 reduction to a separable cubic. That cubic has unique minimum x*=10/(9pi) with Hessian sqrt(3)/24. Compactness and local strict convexity imply global uniqueness in any fixed shrinking C-square, symmetry, the 2:1 gain, and the uniform positive sharp transverse quadratic remainder. Both embedded checks execute successfully. Numerical tests are supportive, not proof.

value.rationale: Determines the precise optimization across unequal two-cap configurations near a physically motivated hyperbolic mean-curvature phase boundary, including uniqueness, no symmetry breaking, sharp transverse stiffness and leading difference between one and two active cuts. These are structural local statements not obtained from merely re-evaluating the already known symmetric branch.
